ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels and 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity region extending from the distal tip toward the medial notch. The right lobe contains a high-intensity field heavily fragmented by dense low-intensity mottled clusters and speckling. The central fluke-peduncle transition is predominantly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with an approximate 110-degree aperture and a pixel-depth of roughly 12-15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge displays 6-8 distinct serrated peaks with moderate pixel-amplitude; the left lobe trailing edge is comparatively smoother with low-frequency micro-irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature tapering into slightly upward-curved distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a subtle concave sweep approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring are distributed across the dark central peduncle region and the lower trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four distinct dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the high-intensity region of the left lobe and two shorter linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe and a high density of white circular scarring at the fluke base near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern localized exclusively within the high-intensity pigmented zone of the right fluke lobe.
